RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel combined with a less experienced male candidate can suggest potential unconscious bias, but it does not constitute proof. Head of group roles heavily weigh commercial acumen, client relationships, and interview rapport alongside technical tenure. 

Directly raising gender bias now carries significant professional risk without established facts. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your written debrief to understand their specific decision criteria. If their explanation reveals inconsistencies, vague rationales, or procedural flaws—or if they stonewall—it may warrant further action. Before raising allegations formally, consult an employment lawyer or trusted professional mentor to evaluate whether a formal grievance or inquiry is justified based on the evidence.
